titleEn: Send store-login one-time codes over WhatsApp

ar: ينفع كود التحقق يوصل على واتساب؟
عملائي مش بيوصلهم الكود على الايميل
en: Can verification codes go over WhatsApp?

steps: Open Bot in Settings, then Switches
Turn Send store-login codes over WhatsApp on: confirm, because each code costs money
Needs your own number and an approved otp_code template; email stays the main channel
edgeCases: Limits: 5 codes per phone per 10 min, 30 per workspace per window
Platform sign-in codes use a separate platform number (WA-OTP-SENDER-1), not the merchant number
Failures: invalid, country_not_allowed, not_found, disabled, no_number, template_unavailable, rate_limited, send_failed, wallet_empty, unavailable
Turning ON needs a single-use confirm token from the preview step; every toggle writes an audit row (store_link.toggle)
